store.summary: 38 kHz Infrared transceiver studio, on-device ML denoiser, universal probe & .ir library
store.description: IR Studio is a pure-Go 38 kHz Infrared laboratory for M5Stack CardputerZero (/dev/lirc*). Capture and decode NEC, NECext, Samsung32, RC5, RC6, SIRC, Kaseikyo, and RAW signals; clean noisy captures with 0-alloc 1D K-Means clustering; classify TV/AC/Noise frames; inspect stateful AC diffs; run Universal Power-Off probes with Smart Rank and 12-slot rewind; manage Flipper .ir remotes and multi-device macros; and expose all capabilities via opt-in stdio MCP over SSH.
